notes.title: Workshop Integration
notes.content:
Workshop Integration is now live!

Try out now, the new and exiting Level Editor. 

Upload to the Steam Workshop with a single click!

Browse through user-created levels, all from within the game.

Included are also 4 workshop related achievements!

notes.title: Update for 27th of October
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

- Maze Levels: Pieces can now be placed even if they block the path
- Fixed path counter animation visual
- Fixed the same hint showing up multiple times
- Removed some pieces from Level 6

[h3]Controller Improvements[/h3]
- Pieces no longer instantly snap to the center when selected
- X/Y now toggles between placed and unused pieces, NumPad loops through the selected state
- and more minor improvements
